_about: Lane A captcha validation config for captcha_check.py. The harness does TWO things: (A) PROVIDER CONTRACT — drives the provider's siteverify endpoint with its PUBLISHED TEST SECRET KEYS to prove the verify+parse contract (deterministic, no human solving, no app needed); (B) APP GATE (fail-closed) — for each protected endpoint it POSTs with NO captcha token and asserts a 4xx (a request accepted without a token is a CRITICAL open-gate finding). If you run the app with the provider TEST keys and set app_configured_with_test_keys=true + always_pass_token, it also asserts pass-token → 2xx and bad/replayed-token → 4xx. The full positive end-to-end needs the app running with TEST keys. Site key is PUBLIC; the secret key is backend-only and NEVER goes in this file.
_provider_choices: recaptcha-v3 | recaptcha-v2 | turnstile. v3 has no public always-pass key, so the provider-contract step exercises the v2 test pair to prove the siteverify contract; the app-gate step is provider-agnostic.
_always_pass_token_about: Only used when app_configured_with_test_keys=true. For Turnstile, a dummy token is fine since the TEST secret 1x…AA always passes; for reCAPTCHA v2 use the test response 6LeIxAcTAAAAAJcZVRqyHh71UMIEGNQ_MXjiZKhI. NEVER a real secret key.
